TUCSON, ARIZONA (June 8, 2026) — Cushman & Wakefield | PICOR, CBRE, Larsen Baker, Grimm Commercial, and other brokerage firms reported 20 commercial lease transactions totaling 113,780 square feet for the week of June 1-5, 2026.
The activity included 55,064 square feet in new leases and expansions and 58,716 square feet in renewals.
NEW LEASES / EXPANSIONS
INDUSTRIAL – DREXEL COMMERCE CENTER, 2740 E. DREXEL ROAD, UNIT 2110, TUCSON, AZ 85706 – SOUTH SUBMARKET
NEFCO Construction Supply LLC leased 24,221 square feet of industrial space at Drexel Commerce Center, 2740 E. Drexel Road, Unit 2110, in Tucson. Tim Healy, Mike Puzzo, and John McCormick with CBRE represented the tenant. Jesse Blum and Alex Demeroutis with CBRE, along with Rob Glaser of Cushman & Wakefield | PICOR, represented the landlord.
OFFICE – 5151 E. BROADWAY OFFICE TOWER, 5151 E. BROADWAY BLVD., SUITES 550, 600 & 620, TUCSON, AZ 85711 – EAST SUBMARKET
Advanced Financial Company expanded its office lease with KCI Broadway, LLC, Scott Seldin-Broadway, LLC, Belmont Broadway, LLC, and Tucson 5151 Investments, LLC for a total of 13,576 square feet of office space at 5151 E. Broadway Office Tower, 5151 E. Broadway Blvd., Suites 550, 600, and 620, in Tucson. Mark Isenberger with Cushman & Wakefield | PICOR represented the landlord.
OFFICE – 275 W. CONTINENTAL ROAD, SUITES 133-141, GREEN VALLEY, AZ 85622 – EXTENDED SOUTH SUBMARKET
Alignment Healthcare USA LLC leased 4,536 square feet of office space at 275 W. Continental Road, Suites 133-141, in Green Valley. David Montijo with CBRE represented the landlord, Sheridan-120 LLC. Thomas Nieman with Cushman & Wakefield | PICOR represented the tenant.
INDUSTRIAL – TUCSON TECH PARK, 1665 E. 18TH ST., SUITE 206, TUCSON, AZ 85719 – CENTRAL SUBMARKET
MagMod leased 3,367 square feet of industrial space at Tucson Tech Park, 1665 E. 18th St., Suite 206, in Tucson, from SBC Investors, LLC. Kameron Norwood, Investment Sales & Leasing Specialist, and Andrew Keim, Industrial Specialist with Cushman & Wakefield | PICOR, represented the landlord.
RETAIL – MONTESA PLAZA, 50 S. HOUGHTON ROAD, SUITES 130 AND 140, TUCSON, AZ 85748 – EAST SUBMARKET
Rozanna Ramirez Corporation dba Desert Beauty Salon leased 1,733 square feet of retail space at Montesa Plaza, 50 S. Houghton Road, Suites 130 and 140, in Tucson. The space was formerly Glenn Royce Salon and will continue to be used for the same purpose. Isaac Figueroa, CCIM, SIOR, and Michelle Ward with Larsen Baker represented the landlord and handled the transaction.
RETAIL – SPEEDWAY CRAYCROFT PLAZA, 5470 E. SPEEDWAY BLVD., SUITE 109A, TUCSON, AZ 85712 – NORTHEAST SUBMARKET
AZ’s Barbershop, LLC leased the 1,664-square-foot end cap retail suite at Speedway Craycroft Plaza, 5470 E. Speedway Blvd., Suite 109A, in Tucson. Isaac Figueroa, CCIM, SIOR, with Larsen Baker represented the landlord and handled the transaction.
OFFICE – NORTH TUCSON BUSINESS CENTER, 3895 N. BUSINESS CENTER DRIVE, SUITE 101, TUCSON, AZ 85705 – CENTRAL SUBMARKET
Lionheart Security International Consulting LLC leased 1,261 square feet of office space at North Tucson Business Center, 3895 N. Business Center Drive, Suite 101, in Tucson, from Pegasus Tucson Owner LLC. Paul Hooker, SIOR, Principal, and Andrew Keim, Industrial Specialists with Cushman & Wakefield | PICOR, represented the landlord.
INDUSTRIAL – TUCSON TECH PARK, 1665 E. 18TH ST., SUITE 118, TUCSON, AZ 85719 – CENTRAL SUBMARKET
Manthra Ventures, LLC dba Sonoran Fleet Care leased 1,220 square feet of industrial space at Tucson Tech Park, 1665 E. 18th St., Suite 118, in Tucson, from SBC Investors, LLC. Kameron Norwood, Investment Sales & Leasing Specialist, and Andrew Keim, Industrial Specialist with Cushman & Wakefield | PICOR, represented the landlord.
OFFICE – SYNERGY PLAZA, 4646 E. FORT LOWELL ROAD, SUITES 106-107, TUCSON, AZ 85712 – NORTHEAST SUBMARKET
Intentional Psychiatry PLLC leased 1,023 square feet of office space at Synergy Plaza, 4646 E. Fort Lowell Road, Suites 106-107, in Tucson. Jason Shaltiel with CBRE represented the landlord, Synergy Plaza LLC. Scott McGill of MCG Realty LLC represented the tenant.
INDUSTRIAL – CENTRAL POINT BUSINESS PLAZA, 3961 E. SPEEDWAY BLVD., SUITE 316, TUCSON, AZ 85712 – NORTHEAST SUBMARKET
Sam’s Tint LLC leased 940 square feet of industrial space at Central Point Business Plaza, 3961 E. Speedway Blvd., Suite 316, in Tucson, from Central Point Tucson, LLC. Molly Mary Gilbert, CCIM, Office Specialist with Cushman & Wakefield | PICOR, represented the landlord. Michael Coretz with Commercial Real Estate Group of Tucson LLC represented the tenant.
OFFICE – HERDER BUILDING, 2033 E. SPEEDWAY BLVD., TUCSON, AZ 85719 – CENTRAL SUBMARKET
Saul Salinas Insurance Agency, Inc., dba Farmers Insurance, leased 850 square feet of office space at the Herder Building, 2033 E. Speedway Blvd., in Tucson. Juan C. Pantoja of Grimm Commercial, LLC, represented the landlord, Zebas Properties, LLC, in the transaction.
OFFICE – 3444 N. COUNTRY CLUB ROAD, SUITE 202, TUCSON, AZ 85716 – CENTRAL SUBMARKET
Home Town Hero Partners LLC leased 673 square feet of office space at 3444 N. Country Club Road, Suite 202, in Tucson, from 3438/3444 CC, LLC. Molly Mary Gilbert, CCIM, Office Specialist with Cushman & Wakefield | PICOR, represented the landlord.
RENEWALS
OFFICE – SUNDT CORP. SOUTHERN AZ HQ, 2015 W. RIVER ROAD, SUITE 125, TUCSON, AZ 85704 – NORTHWEST SUBMARKET
Curriculum Associates, LLC renewed its lease with Sundt Companies, Inc. for 20,328 square feet of office space at Sundt Corp. Southern AZ HQ, 2015 W. River Road, Suite 125, in Tucson. Ryan McGregor, Office Specialist with Cushman & Wakefield | PICOR, represented the landlord. Buzz Isaacson with CBRE, Tucson, represented the tenant.
INDUSTRIAL – 2125 E. BEVERLY DRIVE, TUCSON, AZ 85719 – CENTRAL SUBMARKET
United Refrigeration Inc. renewed its lease with GS Eternal, LLC – Series C for 16,520 square feet of industrial space at 2125 E. Beverly Drive in Tucson. Paul Hooker, SIOR, Principal, Industrial Specialist with Cushman & Wakefield | PICOR, represented the landlord.
INDUSTRIAL – CLAIREMONT PLAZA, 1668 S. RESEARCH LOOP, SUITE 360, TUCSON, AZ 85710 – EAST SUBMARKET
Manufacturing Machining Services LLC renewed its lease with Pegasus Tucson Owner LLC for 11,218 square feet of industrial space at Clairemont Plaza, 1668 S. Research Loop, Suite 360, in Tucson. Paul Hooker, SIOR, Principal, and Andrew Keim, Industrial Specialists with Cushman & Wakefield | PICOR, represented the landlord.
INDUSTRIAL – RUTHRAUFF COMMERCE CENTER, 2450 W. RUTHRAUFF ROAD, SUITE 180, TUCSON, AZ 85705 – CENTRAL SUBMARKET
Southwest Fuel Care, LLC renewed its lease with Pegasus Tucson Owner LLC for 3,300 square feet of industrial space at Ruthrauff Commerce Center, 2450 W. Ruthrauff Road, Suite 180, in Tucson. Paul Hooker, SIOR, Principal, and Andrew Keim, Industrial Specialists with Cushman & Wakefield | PICOR, represented the landlord.
INDUSTRIAL – TUCSON TECH PARK, 1665 E. 18TH ST., SUITE 115, TUCSON, AZ 85719 – CENTRAL SUBMARKET
Boxing Inc. University renewed its lease with SBC Investors, LLC for 3,030 square feet of industrial space at Tucson Tech Park, 1665 E. 18th St., Suite 115, in Tucson. Kameron Norwood, Investment Sales & Leasing Specialist, and Andrew Keim, Industrial Specialist with Cushman & Wakefield | PICOR, represented the landlord.
